references.text: Proverbs also warns against moving ancient boundary stones that the fathers have set up, emphasizing the same principle of respecting established property boundaries.
Repeats the prohibition against moving ancient boundary stones and adds a warning against encroaching on the fatherless's field, because their Redeemer is strong.
A curse is pronounced on anyone who moves their neighbor's boundary stone, showing the seriousness of this offense in Israelite law.
Job describes the wicked as those who move boundary stones and steal others' livestock, showing that this was a known form of injustice.
The prophet Hosea compares Judah's leaders to those who move boundary stones, and the Lord will pour out His wrath on them like water.
